headline: Trump rozważa kolejne uderzenia na Iran. Oto co się dzieje z cenami ropy
summary: Oil prices rose slightly as Donald Trump considers more attacks on Iran and Israel presses for a joint operation. Attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and rising US crude stocks are also in focus.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark. The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so threats there feed directly into crude prices.
why_moved: Prices rose slightly on renewed fears of Middle East escalation, with reports that Trump is considering more strikes on Iran and attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
